description: This file implements a JSON decoder class for the Zend Framework, capable of parsing JSON strings into PHP variables, objects, or arrays. It contains token definitions, parsing logic, and methods for decoding JSON structures.

classes.name: Zend_Json_Decoder
classes.description: A class responsible for decoding JSON strings into PHP variables, with configurable object decoding types, internal token parsing, and recursive decoding methods.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Static method that decodes a JSON encoded string into PHP variables, allowing choice between array or object decoding.

methods.name: _decodeValue
methods.description: Recursively decodes the next value based on the current token; handles objects, arrays, or primitive data types.

methods.name: _decodeObject
methods.description: Decodes a JSON object into either an associative array or a StdClass object based on the configured decode type.

methods.name: _decodeArray
methods.description: Decodes a JSON array into a PHP array.

methods.name: _getNextToken
methods.description: Reads the next token from the JSON source string during parsing.

methods.name: _eatWhitespace
methods.description: Advances the parsing offset past whitespace characters in the source string.
